questions.text: Do you live alone or with other people?
questions.say: Good evening. My name is George, and I'm your examiner today. This is the Speaking test. In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about your home. Do you live alone or with other people?

cueCard.topic: Describe an interesting conversation you had with someone.
points: when and where the conversation happened
cueCard.explain: and explain why you found it interesting.

questions.text: Describe an interesting conversation you had with someone.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe an interesting conversation you had with someone. You should say: who you talked to; when and where the conversation happened; what you talked about; and explain why you found it interesting.

questions.text: Have you talked to this person again since then?
questions.say: Thank you. Have you talked to this person again since then?

questions.text: Why do some people find it easy to talk to strangers?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about an interesting conversation, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all communication. Why do some people find it easy to talk to strangers?

questions.text: What makes someone a good listener?
questions.say: What makes someone a good listener?

questions.text: Do men and women communicate in different ways?
questions.say: Do men and women communicate in different ways?

questions.text: How has the way people keep in touch changed in recent years?
questions.say: Now let's talk about communication and technology. How has the way people keep in touch changed in recent years?

questions.text: Is a conversation on video as good as a conversation face to face?
questions.say: Is a conversation on video as good as a conversation face to face?

questions.text: Do you think children now have weaker communication skills because of technology?
questions.say: Do you think children now have weaker communication skills because of technology?
